checks: Reserved minutes are deducted; exhausted FREE shows pricing action
PRO exhaustion shows support rather than a promised upgrade
Returning actor never restores an old count while pending
Late prior route reply cannot overwrite current route usage
Service plan change refreshes usage for the same account
Loading, guest and missing identity never retain private data
Focus coalesces in-flight reads; deadline and retry recover
Invalid quantities stay unknown, zero is finite and only -1 is unlimited
Malformed response clears previous allowance and offers retry
Unmount aborts pending read and removes listeners
Initial loading never starts a private lookup
Initial guest shows public guest allowance without private lookup
Oversized streamed body fails without publishing an allowance
scope: Actual usage hook, bounded stream reader and extracted real UsageStats JSX under StrictMode; synthetic sessions/routes/responses only. No paid transcription or live account.
